$Comment: The Christmas Board, drawn once a day at midnight UTC, one contract per slot. A slot posts only
contracts whose Boards entry names its Difficulty band. Christmas_Outdoor holds the work out in the
world (Present Thieves, carrots, logs for Santa's fire, eggs); Christmas_Workshop holds what is made
and brought to Santa (cookies, dough, presents, spices).
Santa's favor opens more of the board. The third and fourth slots carry Requires: the second Outdoor
job opens at On the List (the rank id Friendly), the second Workshop job at Nice (Honored). Everyone
sees them posted, and a player below the rank sees them locked, with the reason. Each band has four
contracts for its two slots, so the day's jobs change from one day to the next.
Hosts names Santa, so his quest page (What needs doing?) lists what this board has posted beside his
own quests: a player takes a job there under this board's rules, and hands it in and collects its pay
with him or at the board, wherever they took it.
Grades names each band for the badge on its rows: TitleKey is its words, Color the badge's colour.
Season makes the board absent while Christmas is off. Its contracts' pay waits here until the player
collects it (Rewards.Claim); a job left uncollected when Christmas ends shows Collect in the player's
Objective Book instead, since a contract whose board is gone is collected anywhere. Order 91 keeps it
behind a server's everyday boards. It carries no Where, so it opens in any world and follows Santa
